name: uv-build
description: uv build: builds a Python project's sdist and wheel through its PEP 517 build backend.
title: uv-build

llmHints.on_match: uv build observed. The sdist and wheel in dist/ are recorded by the product attestor. The build backend (build-system.requires) is not in uv.lock; pin it with --build-constraint to make the build reproducible.

positiveSetup: Invoke cilock with argv starting "uv build"
negativeSetup: Invoke cilock with unrelated argv (e.g. `echo unrelated`)
